description: Diagnostic-only BTC first-window ablation removing only the standard three-bar FVG non-overlap requirement from day-liquidity-delivery V1

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged 6 bp. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop execution reserves the shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding hour. Ten-second data is execution infrastructure only. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding and applies native liquidation.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives; funding_interval_hours converted to Nautilus minutes
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding 60 minutes, minimum one tick; independent of direction, route family, target and outcome.

scenario_contract.removed_variable: A five-minute displacement no longer has to create a non-overlapping standard three-bar FVG.
scenario_contract.replacement_observation: The delivery zone collapses to the already-frozen opposing five-minute swing broken by the same displacement. The first later touch must hold that broken swing and close with the H4 draw.
scenario_contract.retained_direction_layer: Only a completed four-hour displacement close through a causally confirmed four-hour swing creates the active draw.
scenario_contract.retained_target_layer: Freeze the nearest still-active completed day/week pool, otherwise a sufficiently distant completed H4 pool; no fitted-R target.
scenario_contract.retained_time_layer: Completed Asia inventory routes Europe and completed Europe inventory routes US; time never supplies direction.
scenario_contract.retained_route_layer: Same raid-reclaim and acceptance-separate-retest session routes as the base candidate.
scenario_contract.retained_displacement_layer: The same later separate five-minute frozen-swing break, prior-body/range displacement and close-location requirement remain.
scenario_contract.retained_entry: First completed ten-second bucket strictly after the first later broken-swing retest closes with the draw.
scenario_contract.retained_stop: Same observed fifteen-minute raid/retest extreme plus fixed 0.05 five-minute ATR buffer.
scenario_contract.retained_risk: Same shared NAV 3 percent expected-loss sizing, fees, one adverse tick, causal stop-slippage and funding reserves.
scenario_contract.promotion_prohibition: This result is diagnostic only. Even a passing result must be rebuilt as a new base candidate and re-evaluated from the beginning.
